info.title: TokenHub API
info.description: Actual new application contract. Direct API paths start /v1. Browser reverse proxy paths start /api/v1 and strip /api before Gin. Customer and staff use HttpOnly tokenhub_session; model API uses a brand-bound Bearer Key. All money/ATG amounts are exact decimal strings. MONEY denotes the independently configured global settlement currency; actual original-currency transfers and supplier reference, reported and statement costs remain separate. Per-payment currency quotes prefer the payment provider and fall back to the configured Frankfurter source. These quotes determine only the payable amount for that order; assets, supplier costs and cross-currency profit are never converted. Domain ownership, permission and business state are enforced server-side. This contract covers all model endpoints and core browser flows; operator commands use explicit request schemas derived from the actual typed workflows and reviewed technical DTOs.

post.description: Requires an active real owner membership on the installed platform operator, verified from the authenticated staff session. Broad permissions, inherited authority or a supplied actor ID are insufficient. confirmed must be true and expected_version must match the current row. effective_at must be in the future according to the database clock. Only unconfigured settings can be scheduled; an existing schedule must first be cancelled. At effectiveness the currency and ATG ratio become permanently immutable, even when every business switch is off. No exchange rate is fetched, stored or inferred.
